decision: Eligible as a single-run same-node comparison of the four fixed deployments on prefix-on C12 / 128 complete sessions.

findings.issue: Original preparation manifest retained parent selection/coverage/length-distribution descriptions.
findings.resolution: Preserved original evidence; public frozen-128 manifest recomputed from verified subset index and exact parent bytes.
findings.effect_on_measurement: none; payload hash/count/session/route audits already use the actual subset

findings.issue: EP4 actual prefill exceeds simulation by 4,927,488 tokens (10.77% of predicted).
findings.resolution: Both predictions and actual results retained; no claim of exact cache/time simulation for the pressure case.

limits: One trial per deployment; order/time/system variation not excluded by repeats.
C12, 128 complete sessions and the frozen dependency/route pattern define this result; 256/C16 is a different workload.
MBT, cache domains, topology, communication and dynamic batching vary by deployment; no isolated AFD mechanism causal estimate.
Equal cached/prefill token counts do not prove identical FLOPs, batch shapes or execution schedules.
Native RUNNING includes computation, communication, batching and execution waits; it is not pure kernel time.
No new full numerical-accuracy evaluation; inherited precision evidence and actual-loaded-runtime/output/stream integrity checked.
Public evidence is field-curated; full machine logs/environments and model/native binaries remain outside Git.
